notes: All 17 snapshot texts listed in chunk-32.json were read; all are Common Crawl captures (sourceUrl = the index lookup address from each file's footer; sourceDate = capture date from the file name). The snapshot directories also hold 2013-05/06 captures that chunk-32.json does not list; those are assigned to chunks 15-17 and were not processed here. Haas BPP and Management of Organizations 'Dissertations & Placements' pages list 'Name, YYYY' followed by a placement line (sometimes absent, e.g. Edward Egan 2012) and the dissertation title; the page does not say whether the year is the degree year or the placement year, so yearMeaning is 'unstated'. Where the placement line carried an explicit role ('; Research Fellow', ', Post Doc', ', Visiting Scholar', 'Postdoctoral Fellow') it was split into destination and position; otherwise destination is the full line as written. Jessica Kennedy (MOR, 2012) is listed with 'University of Pennsylvania, Wharton School of Business, Post Doc' in the 2013-12 capture and with 'Vanderbilt University' in the 2014-11 and 2015-03 captures; she also appears as a 2013-14 job-market candidate. The two Haas job-market pages (academics/jobmarket.html and careers/jobmarket.html) carry identical content; each is recorded separately. Seasons written as ranges (2013-14, 2014-15) are recorded as the closing year (2014, 2015) with the range quoted in note; names and job-market paper titles are as written, including blank paper cells. Kate Ashley (Operations Management, 2014-15) appears in the 2014-11 captures but the Operations Management table is empty in the 2015-03/04 captures. The Haas PhD alumni profiles page lists nine alumni with a 'PhD 10'-style label; listedYear is that label's year, recorded as yearMeaning 'graduation' because the label attaches the year to the PhD, and the destination/position is the affiliation shown in the profile at the capture date (current affiliation, not necessarily the first job); several profiles change between captures (Chee: University of Oregon -> Korea University Business School; Fedyk: Arizona State University -> University of San Francisco; Hartman-Glaser: Duke University -> UCLA Anderson).
